questions.question: Which list is in the correct order from the TOP of the hierarchy to the BOTTOM?

options.text: Management groups, subscriptions, resource groups, resources
Subscriptions, management groups, resources, resource groups
Resource groups, subscriptions, resources, management groups
Resources, resource groups, subscriptions, management groups

questions.question: A user is assigned the Contributor role on a resource group. Where does the permission apply?

options.text: To the resource group and all resources inside it
Only to the resource group object itself

questions.explanation: Role assignments are inherited by child scopes.

questions.question: Where is the best place to assign a company-wide policy?
questions.explanation: Assign broad governance high in the hierarchy so it is inherited.
